# Copilot Instructions

- This is a learning repo for early-career engineers.
- Prefer simple, readable .NET 8 code.
- Keep changes small and focused.
- Add or update tests when behavior changes.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- Do not add secrets.
- Do not invent real company data.
- Use secure coding basics.
- Explain tradeoffs simply.
- Update docs when useful.
